description: This file defines an Android Activity named SelectContactActivity, which displays a list of contacts for the user to select from. It handles its lifecycle, sets up a list view with a custom adapter, responds to item clicks by returning the selected contact's ID, and uses a contact model and view binder to populate contact information.

classes.name: SelectContactActivity
classes.description: An Activity displaying a list of contacts for selection, handling user interaction and returning the selected contact ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, checks the intent action, and sets up the contact list and click listener.

methods.name: mAdapter.getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of contacts available for display.

methods.name: mAdapter.getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the contact at a specified position.

methods.name: mAdapter.getItemId
methods.description: Returns the ID (here, position index) for the contact item.

methods.name: mAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a view for a contact item, binds contact data to the view.

methods.name: mOnItemClickListener.onItemClick
methods.description: Handles contact selection by creating an intent with the selected contact ID, setting the result, and finishing the activity.
